title: Decision
description: An architecture decision record: the context that prompted it, the choice made, and its consequences. Immutable except for the transition to superseded (ADR-014); that comparison spans two versions of the document and is enforced by the core, not by this schema.

allOf.title: A superseded decision names the decision that replaced it

context.description: The situation that made a decision necessary.

consequences.description: The effects of the decision, positive or negative.

status.description: active or superseded. The transition from active to superseded, and the requirement that the previous version was active, is a rule about two versions of the same document and is enforced by the core, not by this schema.

supersededBy.description: The decision that replaces this one.

alternative.description: An option that was considered and set aside, with the reason it was not chosen.
